title: {MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR} template is never defined — the too-far-future date boundary scenario cannot be executed as written
evidence: Scenario: '  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR}"' and description line '  `{MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR}` keeps the pin exactly one month past the'. SKILL.md substitution contract (step 4) lists only five templates: '   - `{RUN_ID}` → the timestamp from preflight' / '   - `{SHORT_CODE}` → vacancy short code from the URL' / '   - `{SCENARIO}` → the scenario slug, e.g. `happy-path/employed-with-rental-history`' / '   - `{TIMESTAMP}` → current epoch (per-scenario, for inner uniqueness)' / '   - `{MOVE_IN_DATE}` → today + 90 days as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. `date -v+90d +%F`)'. Repo-wide grep for MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR matches only this scenario file.
detail: The runner is instructed to substitute only five templates; MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR is not among them, so the literal token goes into a date input (Playwright rejects non-YYYY-MM-DD fills). The +12-month upper-bound branch loses its E2E pin; only the unit test validate_move_in_date_too_far_future_test covers it.
recommended_fix: Document {MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR} (today + 13 months, YYYY-MM-DD) in SKILL.md step 4 and the template reference section, alongside {MOVE_IN_DATE}.

title: Stepper behaviour on the form-errors re-render (start at first error section, anchor-click routing) has no E2E coverage
detail: firstErrorIndex/resolveAnchorTarget/focusTargetFor are node-tested as pure functions and SSR tests pin script presence, but the click-routing and show(idx) wiring on an error re-render is exercised nowhere; all 18 validation scenarios bypass the stepper via stepper=off.
recommended_fix: Add one E2E scenario with stepper: true that submits invalid data, then asserts the stepper restarts on the first error's section and an error-summary anchor click switches steps.

title: form.js preflight display:flex fix is asserted nowhere — the invisible-error regression can silently revert
detail: The E2E client_block assertion checks the span 'is populated' (textContent); reverting style.display = "flex" keeps textContent set, so every check stays green while the named Perkins r1 regression (invisible per-file error) returns. No node test imports form.js.
recommended_fix: Extend the client_block assertion (or files/oversize-file.yaml) to require the inline error span be visible (computed display not none), not merely populated.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Makefile: 'test: test-shared test-client test-server test-js'. Diff adds SSR pins (form_sections_render_in_funnel_dom_order_test, no_js_fallback_all_fieldsets_render_without_hidden_test, attestation_card_carries_stepper_gating_message_test, stepper_script_loads_and_chrome_is_js_built_test, pristine_form_omits_listing_source_test, address_cluster_collapsed_pristine_open_when_prefilled_test, upload_slot_error_renders_visibly_test, document_slots_carry_what_counts_helper_copy_test), ~30 node tests in form_stepper.test.js, and one E2E scenario (stepper-happy-path.yaml).
detail: P0 100% (stepper core flow, no-JS fallback SSR pins, listing_source contract incl. DB integration test, attestation gating — all covered). P1 ≈85%: error-rerender stepper wiring and form.js preflight visibility are PARTIAL. P2: one broken boundary scenario (MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR). Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Raise to PASS by landing the three fixes above: document MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR, add a stepper-on validation-error E2E scenario, and assert inline-error visibility in a client_block scenario.
